decisions.reason: Core psychiatric day-patient program with low marginal cost and an existing page, so the firm holds the option while demand uncertainty resolves.
Carpentry workshop is less central and has moderate costs, but its dedicated page and still-uncertain custom-furniture demand justify keeping the option open.
Outpatient sociotherapy is very close to established care and cheap to run as a pilot, so the firm keeps learning about demand.
Sheltered-workshop retail shop is mission-aligned but peripheral and only mentioned, so its higher operating uncertainty gives it a higher drop probability while still keeping the option.
Meal delivery for seniors is close to the eldercare core and newly launched, so the firm keeps this low-cost option open while early demand signals accumulate.
